method: Direct model visual inspection of the exact final-code PNG evidence through the local image viewer, cross-checked against browser geometry in visual/RESULTS.json.

The final contextual guidance, next-anchor note and complete English credits/license/provenance footer are visible and readable; inline mathematics and links do not overflow.
At 390px the Shahmukhi title, navigation, scope note and opening prose wrap within the viewport; no text, focus surface or rule is clipped horizontally.
The saved full 390px page contains the entire source section, learner guidance and credits in one continuous column with no missing region or document-level horizontal displacement.

The complete three-panel cluster is captured: every original raster fits wholly within 390px, and each Punjabi semantic reconstruction presents the full LTR mathematics at readable size—original order and groups, reordered groups, then 3x² + 7x + 12—with no sideways scrolling.

The narrow worked-example viewport preserves visible left and right endpoints of each raster that appears and shows the responsive panels in normal reading order without overlap; no mathematical edge is hidden behind a scroll region.

limitations: The full-page images are also validated by computed browser geometry because fitting a very tall page to a review canvas reduces apparent text size.
The semantic narrow-screen panels are explicitly marked as original responsive reconstructions and do not replace or modify the canonical JPEGs.
